results.description:
uBO Lite (uBOL) is a reliable and efficient content blocker.

The default ruleset corresponds to uBlock Origin's default filterset:

- uBlock Origin's built-in filter lists
- EasyList
- EasyPrivacy
- Peter Lowe’s Ad and tracking server list

You can enable more rulesets by visiting the options page -- click the _Cogs_ icon in the popup panel.

uBOL is entirely declarative, meaning there is no need for a permanent uBOL process for the filtering to occur, and CSS/JS injection-based content filtering is performed reliably by the browser itself rather than by the extension. This means that uBOL itself does not consume CPU/memory resources while content blocking is ongoing -- uBOL's service worker process is required _only_ when you interact with the popup panel or the option pages.

results.description:
1Blocker lets you block obtrusive ads, sneaky trackers, and annoying elements on sites. With 1Blocker, you’re safe online and nothing will distract you from enjoying sites.

1Blocker is very easy to use — just flip a couple of switches to start blocking ads and trackers. The app will automatically receive cloud updates to the built-in filters silently, so you don’t need to do anything. It’s as simple as setting and forgetting.

1Blocker is a fully native app designed to extend Safari naturally. It’s lightweight and doesn’t drain your battery by taking up your device’s resources.

The blocking itself is super fast because Safari does it itself. We only provide filters to Safari and don’t modify webpages in any way. This vastly improves efficiency because Safari knows in advance what should be blocked. So, with 1Blocker, sites load on average 2-5x faster.

It’s important to note that not all ads can be blocked though. Some sites use techniques that make it impossible for us to block their ads using currently available features for Safari content blockers.

SECURE BY DESIGN

1Blocker is secure and private. It doesn’t have access to webpages and doesn’t track you in any way.

We believe that privacy is not for sale. That's why we don't have an "Acceptable Ads" program. We stay independent, and the only way we make money is through direct sales of 1Blocker in the App Store to you.

ADVANCED CUSTOMIZATION

1Blocker is a highly customizable content blocker, providing the possibility to create powerful custom rules. It allows you to create custom rules that block any URL by providing a regular expression or hide any element by CSS. It also lets you block cookies. (Available in Premium)

AVAILABLE ON ALL DEVICES

1Blocker is available for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Your preferences and custom rules are always in sync through iCloud no matter which device you're using.

FEATURED IN THE PRESS

1Blocker has been featured in TechCrunch, Lifehacker, MacStories, Macworld, and many more.

FEATURES AVAILABLE FOR FREE

• The ability to enable one category (for example, Block Ads only)
• Whitelisting sites right from the Safari extension
• Whitelist synchronization between devices via iCloud

FRIENDLY SUPPORT

Send your feedback at @1BlockerApp on Twitter or via email. Your feedback is always very welcome and considered for the next release.


We have been making 1Blocker since 2015. We believe it’s the best all-around package currently available in the App Store.

results.description:
Darker is a Safari extension that automatically adds a dark mode to every website you visit.

It makes browsing the web at night so much better. With Darker, you won’t be blinded by bright websites ever again.

The main features are:
- apply dark mode to various web sites
- Enable night shift - yellow tint that helps your eyes
- Make web pages easier to read
- Read comfortable in night
- Save battery power
- Customizable background color
- Customizable background opacity with a slider

Privacy Policy:
• The Darker extension requires access to the websites you visit to analyze the existing style of the page and to override it with Darker's dark style.
• Darker never collects your browsing data. The only data Darker ‘collects’ are your settings, and those will never leave your device.

-- HOW TO SETUP --

1. Please open the app and click the button on the welcome screen. This will take you to the Settings screen. Then tap Safari (for iPad, check left pane) > Extensions > Darker, then tap the switch to turn it on.

2: On the same screen, tap All Websites > Allow to grant permission to run Darker's extension on Safari on all websites. Now you're all set!

Note: You can tap the "Manage Extensions" icon in your Safari address bar to access the Darker settings.

Note: Safari may display a notice saying that the extension can read your sensitive information and browsing history. This is a general reminder that appears with every extension. Darker will never read or collect any of your personal information such as passwords or credit card numbers. It's completely safe to use. You have my word!

The extension will work on Safari for iOS/iPadOS version 15.0 and above.

results.description:
The internet. As it should be.

Firefox is a private web browser designed to protect your data, block trackers and make browsing fast, secure and simple. Whether you’re looking for an incognito browser, a private search experience, or a reliable browser for everyday use, Firefox puts you first.

Why people choose Firefox:

More privacy, less tracking – Firefox automatically blocks social media trackers, cross-site cookies, crypto miners and fingerprinting scripts.
Private browsing that protects you – Open private tabs that don’t save your history, searches, or cookies. Lock them with your device security for extra protection.
Fewer ads, less clutter – Turn on built-in ad blocking to cut down on distracting ads, leaving more room for what you actually came to see.
Fast, smooth performance – Load pages faster by blocking trackers and reducing unnecessary data usage.
Get Quick Answers – Ask Firefox a question by voice for a clear answer without digging through search results. 
Quick page summaries – Shake your phone to cut through long pages and get the key points.
Tabs that work for you – Easily organize and switch between tabs and sync them across devices to pick up where you left off.
Focus without distractions – Reader View strips away clutter, while picture-in-picture lets you multitask with videos.
Passwords made simple – Generate, store and autofill passwords securely.
Search your way – Use your preferred private search engine or switch easily from the search bar.
Control your experience – Add extensions like ad blockers, customize settings and choose how you browse.
AI on your terms – Turn AI completely off or customize it feature by feature.
Sync across devices – Access your bookmarks, tabs and passwords anywhere you use Firefox.
Make it yours – Customize your home screen, layout and shortcuts for a more personal browsing experience.

Private by default.

Firefox is built to protect you. Enhanced Tracking Protection automatically blocks common trackers, and you can also turn on the built-in ad blocker for more control over your browsing and fewer distracting ads. When you need more privacy, private browsing mode ensures your history, searches and cookies aren’t saved.

Your browser. Your rules.

Firefox puts you in charge of your internet. Add privacy or productivity extensions, including ad blockers, move your search bar, choose your default search engine and tailor your browser to how you use the web. Sync your data across devices for a seamless, consistent experience.


Focus with Firefox. Fast, secure and built around you.

Firefox is designed to help you stay focused with faster, more secure browsing. Reader Mode removes clutter from articles, Picture-in-Picture keeps videos accessible while you multitask and Tracker Blocking helps pages load faster. Built-in password management and private browsing keep everyday browsing simple and protected.

Built for people, not profit.

Firefox was created in 2004 by Mozilla as a faster, more private and customizable browser designed to put people first. Today, Mozilla remains a nonprofit working to make the internet — and the time you spend on it — better.

Noir is a Safari extension that automatically adds a dark mode to every website you visit.

It makes browsing the web at night so much better. With Noir, you won’t be blinded by bright websites ever again.

And the results look great too. Noir generates a custom dark style for each website you visit, based on the colors that are used on a page. You won’t even notice this happening in the background – that’s how fast it is – but you’ll certainly appreciate the end result: a beautiful dark mode tailored for each website, where contrast is preserved and highlights still pop. And with over 20 built-in themes and the ability to create your own, you can customize the results exactly the way you want.

Noir works with any website you visit in Safari, automatically. By default, Noir is linked to your device’s Dark Mode, so websites will only go dark when you want them to. But you can easily customize this to your liking, even per website. Only want to use Noir on just a few specific websites? Sure thing! Disable Noir on some websites? No problem!

Built from the ground up for iOS and iPadOS, the app feels right at home on your device. It supports the brand new Safari web extension feature, which means there’s no need to manually activate it every time you load a new page. The app also tightly integrates with system features such as Shortcuts, Control Center, Focus Filters, and Widgets to fully integrate Noir in all your workflows. And your settings are automatically synced to all your devices using iCloud.

And just as importantly, Noir takes your privacy seriously: it doesn’t collect any of your browsing data. Period.

Noir is made by an indie iOS developer. It does not include any subscriptions or ads. Buy Noir once, use it forever.

Notes:

results.description:
On iPhone Duo's external display, Safari keeps web pages clear of its own buttons and leaves an empty strip down one side. Overspill lets pages spill into that space.

Turn it on from Safari's page menu and the page widens to use the whole screen. Safari's buttons stay where they are and float over the content.

WHAT IT DOES
• Overlay mode: one tap makes page content run edge to edge, underneath Safari's buttons.
• Camera-aware menus: small menu buttons that would end up under the camera are nudged to the left so you can still tap them, and neighbouring buttons are kept from overlapping.
• Everything else is left alone: only small controls near the camera move. The rest of the page stays as the site designed it.
• Remembers your choice: switch it on once and it stays on until you switch it off.
• Guided setup: a short interactive guide in the app walks you through enabling the extension and trying it out, and ticks each step only when you have really done it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Overspill doesn't collect, store or send any data about you or the sites you visit. There is no account, no analytics and no network access. It remembers whether the overlay is on, and whether and when it last ran, so the app's setup guide can show your real progress. All of that stays on your device.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Designed for iPhone Duo's external display. On displays where Safari doesn't reserve a side strip, Overspill has no visible effect.
• Overspill needs your permission to adjust pages. You choose which websites it can run on in Settings > Apps > Safari > Extensions.
• Websites build their menus in many different ways. If a page looks odd, switch Overspill off from the same Safari menu and the page returns to normal.
